units.leftText: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
units.rightText: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon our beloved and fellow-worker,

units.leftText: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
units.rightText: and to Apphia our sister, and to Archippus our fellow-soldier, and to the church in thy house:

units.leftText: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

units.leftText: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
units.rightText: I thank my God always, making mention of thee in my prayers,

units.leftText: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
units.rightText: hearing of thy love, and of the faith which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints;

units.leftText: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
units.rightText: that the fellowship of thy faith may become effectual, in the knowledge of every good thing which is in you, unto Christ.

units.leftText: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
units.rightText: For I had much joy and comfort in thy love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through thee, brother.

units.leftText: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
units.rightText: Wherefore, though I have all boldness in Christ to enjoin thee that which is befitting,

units.leftText: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
units.rightText: yet for love’s sake I rather beseech, being such a one as Paul the aged, and now a prisoner also of Christ Jesus:

units.leftText: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,
units.rightText: I beseech thee for my child, whom I have begotten in my bonds, Onesimus,

units.leftText: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
units.rightText: who once was unprofitable to thee, but now is profitable to thee and to me:

units.leftText: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
units.rightText: whom I have sent back to thee in his own person, that is, my very heart:

units.leftText: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.
units.rightText: whom I would fain have kept with me, that in thy behalf he might minister unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

units.leftText: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
units.rightText: but without thy mind I would do nothing; that thy goodness should not be as of necessity, but of free will.

units.leftText: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,
units.rightText: For perhaps he was therefore parted from thee for a season, that thou shouldest have him for ever;

units.leftText: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
units.rightText: no longer as a servant, but more than a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much rather to thee, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

units.leftText: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
units.rightText: If then thou countest me a partner, receive him as myself.

units.leftText: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
units.rightText: But if he hath wronged thee at all, or oweth thee aught, put that to mine account;

units.leftText: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
units.rightText: I Paul write it with mine own hand, I will repay it: that I say not unto thee that thou owest to me even thine own self besides.

units.leftText: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
units.rightText: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my heart in Christ.

units.leftText: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
units.rightText: Having confidence in thine obedience I write unto thee, knowing that thou wilt do even beyond what I say.

units.leftText: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
units.rightText: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I hope that through your prayers I shall be granted unto you.

units.leftText: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
units.rightText: Epaphras, my fellow-prisoner in Christ Jesus, saluteth thee;

units.leftText: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
units.rightText: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke, my fellow-workers.

units.leftText: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
units.rightText: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
